explanation: The theorem says that if S is a short exact sequence of sheaves of abelian groups on a quasi-separated, compact, prespectral space X and S.X₁ is quasi-flasque, then S.g is surjective on global sections. Mathlib has no notion of quasi-flasque. A grep for QuasiFlasque found nothing, and IsFlasque appears only in Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves/Flasque.lean. The closest declaration there is TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.epi_of_shortExact, which assumes S.X₁ is flasque. That hypothesis is stronger than quasi-flasque, so it cannot give this result. The library's own proof uses its own lemma epi_app_of_shortExact, which is not in Mathlib.
